records.jp: おそらくだけど、詩は過去に大きな事件があって、<CR>それをきっかけに性格を変化させたのだと思う
records.en_original: It's likely that an incident in Uta's past affected her personality greatly.
records.en_auxiliary: It's likely that an incident in Uta's past affected her personality greatly.
records.en: This is only a guess, but I think a major incident<CR>in Uta's past caused her personality to change.

records.jp: 詩は、その“大きな事件”を忘れてしまったから、<CR>性格も変化する前に戻っている
records.en_original: Forgetting that incident must have reverted her personality back to how she was before it altered her.
records.en_auxiliary: Forgetting that incident must have reverted her personality back to how she was before it altered her.
records.en: Because Uta has forgotten that "major incident," her personality has<CR>reverted to how it was before the change.

records.jp: 駒川さん――いえ、詩は、<CR>危険な思想を持つ人物だった
records.en_original: Uta's thought process was...dangerous.
records.en_auxiliary: Uta's thought process was...dangerous.
records.en: Komagawa-san—no, Uta—was<CR>someone with dangerous ideas.

records.jp: 痛みを愛する、歪んだ性格になったきっかけ……<CR>それを思い出せば、彼女は元の詩に戻るでしょうね
records.en_original: Whatever happened twisted her into someone who loved to be inflicted with pain. If she remembers, it's likely that she'll return to that.
records.en_auxiliary: Whatever happened twisted her into someone who loved to be inflicted with pain. If she remembers, it's likely that she'll return to that.
records.en: The event that turned her into a twisted person who loved pain...<CR>If she remembers it, she will return to the old Uta.

records.jp: ……本当に大丈夫なの？
records.en_original: Are we sure that's a good idea?
records.en_auxiliary: Are we sure that's a good idea?
records.en: Are we sure that's a good idea?

records.jp: 元に戻るくらいなら、「きれいな詩」のまま<CR>置いておくのが一番安全なんじゃない？
records.en_original: Wouldn't it be much safer to have Komagawa remain as she is now?
records.en_auxiliary: Wouldn't it be much safer to have Komagawa remain as she is now?
records.en: Would it not be safest to leave her as the "clean<CR>Uta" rather than let her return to how she was?

records.jp: それが一番、危険がない方法……
records.en_original: That would be the safest option...
records.en_auxiliary: That would be the safest option...
records.en: That would be the safest option...

records.jp: でも駒川さんなら、<CR>何か重大なことを知ってるかもしれないよ……
records.en_original: But there is a chance Uta knows something really important.
records.en_auxiliary: But there is a chance Uta knows something really important.
records.en: But there is a chance<CR>Komagawa-san knows something really important.

records.jp: 居場所を調べるなんて簡単です。<CR>私、神の力が使えますから♪
records.en_original: Finding a person is nothing when you have the power of a god.
records.en_auxiliary: Finding a person is nothing when you have the power of a god.
records.en: Finding out where someone is would be easy.<CR>I can use the power of a god, after all♪

records.jp: “神の力”……。<CR>確かに、何のことを言っていたのか気になるね
records.en_original: I wonder what she meant by that...
records.en_auxiliary: I wonder what she meant by that...
records.en: The "power of a god"...<CR>I am curious what she meant by that.

records.jp: で、でも、駒川さんですよ？<CR>皆さんにも危害が及ぶかも……
records.en_original: B-but this is Uta we're talking about! She might hurt everybody here...
records.en_auxiliary: B-but this is Uta we're talking about! She might hurt everybody here...
records.en: B-but this is Komagawa-san we're talking about!<CR>She might hurt everybody here...

records.jp: ここは閉ざされた世界だから、<CR>良くも悪くも逃げ場がない
records.en_original: If something happens in this world, there is no escape.
records.en_auxiliary: If something happens in this world, there is no escape.
records.en: This is a closed world, so for better or<CR>worse, there is nowhere to run.

records.jp: 仮に詩が暴れだせば、力づくで止めるしかなくなる。<CR>その事態は、避けたほうがいいと思う
records.en_original: If Uta turns violent, we'll have no choice but to stop her by force. I think we should avoid such a situation if possible.
records.en_auxiliary: If Uta turns violent, we'll have no choice but to stop her by force. I think we should avoid such a situation if possible.
records.en: If Uta turns violent, we'll have no choice but to stop her by force.<CR>I think we should avoid such a situation if possible.

records.jp: 私も同じ意見
records.en_original: Agreed.
records.en_auxiliary: Agreed.
records.en: Agreed.

records.jp: 逃げ場がないこの場所で、わざわざ危険人物を<CR>起こすようなことはしないほうがいい
records.en_original: If there is no chance of escape, I think it's best we let sleeping dogs lie.
records.en_auxiliary: If there is no chance of escape, I think it's best we let sleeping dogs lie.
records.en: In a place with no escape, we should not<CR>deliberately awaken a dangerous person.

records.jp: それは……ライムを助けるのはあきらめて、<CR>この世界で生きていけばいい……そう言ってる？
records.en_original: Are you suggesting we give up trying to save Lime and live in this world forever?
records.en_auxiliary: Are you suggesting we give up trying to save Lime and live in this world forever?
records.en: Are you saying... that we should give up on<CR>saving Lime and simply live in this world...?

records.jp: そうは言ってない！
records.en_original: Of course not!
records.en_auxiliary: Of course not!
records.en: Of course not!

records.jp: リーダー、あなたの意見は？
records.en_original: Ao, what do you think?
records.en_auxiliary: Ao, what do you think?
records.en: Leader, what is your opinion?

records.jp: （詩さんを知る人たちは、みんな<CR>元の「歪んだ詩さん」に戻るのを恐れてる……）
records.en_original: (Everyone who knew Uta is scared of her going back to what she was...)
records.en_auxiliary: (Everyone who knew Uta is scared of her going back to what she was...)
records.en: (Everyone who knows Uta-san is afraid<CR>that she will return to the "old, warped Uta-san"...)

records.jp: （確かに、みんなの言っている詩さんや、<CR>ココロトープで見た詩さんは危なそうな人だった）
records.en_original: (But it's true that the girl we heard about and saw in the Heartscape is extremely dangerous.)
records.en_auxiliary: (But it's true that the girl we heard about and saw in the Heartscape is extremely dangerous.)
records.en: (The Uta-san everyone talks about and the Uta-san<CR>I saw in the Heartscape certainly seemed dangerous.)

records.en_original: (But still...)
records.en_auxiliary: (But still...)
records.en: (But still...)

records.jp: 私は……ごめん、<CR>やっぱり記憶は取り戻すべきだと思う
records.en_original: I... I'm sorry. I think we should help her regain her memories.
records.en_auxiliary: I... I'm sorry. I think we should help her regain her memories.
records.en: I... I'm sorry.<CR>I think we should help her regain her memories.

records.jp: ライムさんを犠牲にし続けるなんて、できないよ。<CR>詩さんの記憶を取り戻して……前に進まなきゃ
records.en_original: I can't let Lime to continue to sacrifice herself like this. We have to help Uta so that we can keep moving forward.
records.en_auxiliary: I can't let Lime to continue to sacrifice herself like this. We have to help Uta so that we can keep moving forward.
records.en: We can't keep letting Lime-san sacrifice herself.<CR>We have to restore Uta-san's memories... and move forward.

records.jp: それに……記憶って大切なものだと思うんだ
records.en_original: And besides... I think memories are very important.
records.en_auxiliary: And besides... I think memories are very important.
records.en: And besides... I think memories are very important.

records.jp: みんなのココロトープを回ってさ。<CR>記憶の中に、たくさんの想いが詰まってるのを見てきた
records.en_original: All of the memories in all of the Heartscapes meant so much to the people who owned them.
records.en_auxiliary: All of the memories in all of the Heartscapes meant so much to the people who owned them.
records.en: We've gone through everyone's Heartscapes<CR>and seen so many feelings packed into their memories.

records.jp: どれも大事な想いだった。<CR>忘れたままにしちゃいけないものばっかりだった
records.en_original: Each one was important. They couldn't go on being forgotten.
records.en_auxiliary: Each one was important. They couldn't go on being forgotten.
records.en: Every one of them held important feelings.<CR>None of them should have remained forgotten.

records.jp: きっと詩さんにだってそういう想いがあって……。<CR>それを失くして、今、とても苦しんでる
records.en_original: I'm sure that Uta is just like everyone else. She's hurting without her memories.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm sure that Uta is just like everyone else. She's hurting without her memories.
records.en: I'm sure Uta-san has feelings like that too...<CR>and losing them is causing her so much pain now.

records.jp: そんな詩さんに、<CR>「記憶を取り戻すな」なんて……私……
records.en_original: I can't just tell her that she doesn't have the right to get her memories back...
records.en_auxiliary: I can't just tell her that she doesn't have the right to get her memories back...
records.en: To tell Uta-san, while she's suffering like that,<CR>'Don't get your memories back'... I can't...

records.jp: ……ずるい。<CR>そんな風に言われたら、私、何も言えないじゃない
records.en_original: ...How am I supposed to argue with that?
records.en_auxiliary: ...How am I supposed to argue with that?
records.en: ...That's not fair.<CR>If you put it that way, I can't say anything.

records.jp: 記憶を取り戻すな。今の私には、<CR>それがどんなに酷いことか、わかるから……
records.en_original: Especially when I know how cruel it is...
records.en_auxiliary: Especially when I know how cruel it is...
records.en: I know now how cruel it is<CR>to tell someone not to get their memories back...

records.jp: ……うん、そうだよね
records.en_original: Yeah... You're right.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah... You're right.
records.en: Yeah... You're right.

records.jp: どんな記憶も、想いも……勝手に奪うなんて許されない
records.en_original: No memory or emotion is too small to be forgotten.
records.en_auxiliary: No memory or emotion is too small to be forgotten.
records.en: No one has the right to take away any memory or feeling.

records.jp: そうだよね、お姉ちゃん？
records.en_original: Right, Mio?
records.en_auxiliary: Right, Mio?
records.en: Right, Onee-chan?

records.jp: ……そうね。また、間違えるところだった
records.en_original: ...You're right. I almost made the same mistake once again.
records.en_auxiliary: ...You're right. I almost made the same mistake once again.
records.en: ...You are right. I almost made the same mistake again.

records.jp: 確かに、取り戻した記憶が私たちに味方するとは<CR>限らない
records.en_original: There is a chance that her memories will cause her to turn against us.
records.en_auxiliary: There is a chance that her memories will cause her to turn against us.
records.en: There is a chance that her memories will cause her to turn<CR>against us.

records.jp: それでも私たちは、ちゃんと記憶を取り戻した詩と<CR>向き合わなければいけないのかもしれない
records.en_original: Regardless, it is the Uta with all her memories that we must confront.
records.en_auxiliary: Regardless, it is the Uta with all her memories that we must confront.
records.en: Even so, maybe we have to face Uta<CR>after she gets all her memories back.

records.jp: ……そうですね。悪いことをしたのは、<CR>今の駒川さんではないですから……
records.en_original: I agree... The Uta here didn't do anything wrong...
records.en_auxiliary: I agree... The Uta here didn't do anything wrong...
records.en: ...Yes. The one who did those terrible things<CR>wasn't the Komagawa-san who's here now...

records.jp: それは、確かに……
records.en_original: It's true...
records.en_auxiliary: It's true...
records.en: It's true...

records.jp: ……不安は拭えないかもしれない……けど
records.en_original: Honestly, I'm still a little scared, but...
records.en_auxiliary: Honestly, I'm still a little scared, but...
records.en: ...We may not be able to dispel all our anxiety, but...

records.jp: 詩さんの記憶を取り戻す。<CR>みんな、それでいいかな？
records.en_original: We're going to help Uta regain her memories. Is everybody okay with that?
records.en_auxiliary: We're going to help Uta regain her memories. Is everybody okay with that?
records.en: We're going to help Uta-san regain her memories.<CR>Is everybody okay with that?

records.jp: うん！
records.en_original: Yeah!
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah!
records.en: Yeah!

records.jp: わたしもそれでいいと思う
records.en_original: No complaints here.
records.en_auxiliary: No complaints here.
records.en: I think that's fine too.

records.jp: 伶那さんも、いいかな？
records.en_original: Are you with us, Rena?
records.en_auxiliary: Are you with us, Rena?
records.en: Are you with us, Rena-san?

records.jp: ……わかった。<CR>いつまでもごたごた言ってても何も進まないもんね……
records.en_original: ...Fine. Standing around talking like this won't get us anywhere.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Fine. Standing around talking like this won't get us anywhere.
records.en: ...Fine.<CR>Nothing will move forward if we keep arguing forever...

records.jp: ……ありがとう
records.en_original: Thanks.
records.en_auxiliary: Thanks.
records.en: Thanks.

records.jp: 暴れた時の対処法だけは後で話しておきましょう
records.en_original: We should at least discuss what to do in case she does become violent.
records.en_auxiliary: We should at least discuss what to do in case she does become violent.
records.en: We should at least discuss what to do if she becomes violent.

records.jp: ……これで話はまとまった
records.en_original: So it's settled, then.
records.en_auxiliary: So it's settled, then.
records.en: So it's settled, then.

records.jp: うん。……行こう、記憶を取り戻しに
records.en_original: Right. Now let's go get Uta's memories back.
records.en_auxiliary: Right. Now let's go get Uta's memories back.
records.en: Right. ...Let's go recover her memories.
